extracted.name: Slow Cooker Taco Bean Soup
extracted.description: This slow cooker taco bean soup recipe with six types of canned beans is very versatile. But you can use any combination of beans you like, even corn.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can red kidney beans, undrained
1 (15 ounce) can white kidney beans, undrained
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instruction_lines: Cook and stir ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 10 minutes; drain fat. Transfer beef to a slow cooker. Add onion; sprinkle in taco seasoning.
Stir white beans, red kidney beans, white kidney beans, ranch-style beans, pinto beans, black beans, hominy, and tomatoes with green chiles into beef mixture. Cover slow cooker.
Cook on Low until cooked through and flavors blend, 4 to 5 hours.
